items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued October 19 at 6:51PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
A moderate storm system will impact our coastal waters Wednesday
through Thursday. Activity is likely to be most hazardous for
the waters south and east of Point Conception with peak timing
expected Wednesday afternoon through Thursday morning.

Any thunderstorm that forms will be capable of producing locally
gale force winds and rough seas, dangerous lightning, heavy
rainfall with reduced visibility, and waterspouts..
